query: WITH filtered AS (SELECT deployment.id, deployment.name, deployment.registry, deployment.repository_id, deployment.image_name, deployment.image_tag, deployment.status, deployment.runner, deployment.machine_type, deployment.current_live_digest, resource.created FROM deployment INNER JOIN RESOURCES_WITH_PERMISSION_FOR_LOGIN_ID($2, $3) AS resource ON deployment.id = resource.id WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND deployment.deleted IS NULL AND ($4::TEXT IS NULL OR deployment.name ILIKE '%' || $4 || '%') AND ($5::TEXT IS NULL OR deployment.image_tag = $5) AND ($6::DEPLOYMENT_STATUS[] IS NULL OR deployment.status = ANY($6)) AND ($7::UUID IS NULL OR deployment.runner = $7) AND ($8::TEXT IS NULL OR deployment.current_live_digest = $8)) SELECT page.id AS "id?", page.name AS "name?", page.registry AS "registry?", page.repository_id AS "repository_id?", page.image_name AS "image_name?", page.image_tag AS "image_tag?", page.status AS "status?: DeploymentStatus", page.runner AS "runner?", page.machine_type AS "machine_type?", page.current_live_digest AS "current_live_digest?", total.count AS "total_count!" FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM filtered) AS total LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM filtered ORDER BY created DESC LIMIT $9 OFFSET $10) AS page ON TRUE;
